stories.headline: Anthropic just launched a team to help governments defend critical infrastructure
stories.blurb: Anthropic's new Cyber Mission unit will work with the U.S. and allied governments to deploy Claude for cybersecurity defense — think protecting power grids, water systems, and transportation networks from AI-powered attacks. The team includes former NSA and White House cyber officials.
stories.why_it_matters: AI companies are now building specialized government defense teams as cyber threats become AI-augmented.

stories.headline: Anthropic will scan your open-source code for security holes, for free
stories.blurb: Anthropic just launched OSS Scanner, a free service that uses Claude to find security vulnerabilities in open-source projects. Maintainers who opt in get periodic scans from Anthropic's strongest models at no cost, potentially catching issues earlier in the development cycle.
stories.why_it_matters: Free AI security scanning could help small open-source teams catch bugs they'd otherwise miss.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects

stories.headline: Arena, the site that ranks AI models, just hit a $3.1B valuation
stories.blurb: The company behind LMArena—the leaderboard where people vote on which AI gives better answers—raised $200 million from Lightspeed and Khosla. It's now worth $3.1 billion, nearly double its valuation from 10 months ago. Arena is expanding beyond quality rankings to measure whether models lie or follow instructions poorly.
stories.why_it_matters: The neutral benchmark everyone uses to compare models is now a multi-billion-dollar business.
stories.original_headline: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months

stories.headline: Andreessen Horowitz backs viral AI model Jev at $7.5 billion
stories.blurb: TypeSafe AI raised $870 million just weeks after launching Jev, an AI model that went viral immediately. Andreessen Horowitz led the round, valuing the startup at $7.5 billion despite having barely any operating history.
stories.why_it_matters: A viral launch can now command unicorn valuations in weeks, not years.
stories.original_headline: Andreessen Horowitz Backs Jev Maker at $7.5 Billion Value

stories.headline: Google's new app transcribes meetings on your laptop with zero internet
stories.blurb: Google released a free experimental note-taking app called AI Edge Foresight that transcribes and summarizes meetings entirely offline on macOS. It runs a local AI model on your device, so nothing gets sent to the cloud—similar to apps like Granola and Wispr Flow, but without needing connectivity.
stories.why_it_matters: Private meetings can now stay fully offline while still getting AI transcription and summaries.
stories.original_headline: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline

stories.headline: Cursor's iOS app can now control coding agents running on your Mac
stories.blurb: Cursor just shipped remote control for local agents — you can now see what AI is building on your laptop and reply from your phone. The feature works through the Cursor iOS app, letting you supervise and steer agent runs without being at your desk.
stories.why_it_matters: You can now babysit long-running AI builds from anywhere, not just your laptop.
